definition: `IsMaximalIn InAct MoreIn r m`: m has the perfection r and nothing is more r than m. Maximal, not greatest: it does not say that m is more r than everything else, so it does not by itself give uniqueness.
note: IsMaximalIn is the canonical spelling of the same body; IsMaximumIn remains its definitionally equal public compatibility name. This does not strengthen maximality to greatestness; see docs/notes/infinite-greatest-whole.md. Lean locator uses the canonical IsMaximalIn spelling. Its body unfolds to the existing IsMaximumIn compatibility definition, InAct m r ∧ ∀ y, ¬ MoreIn r y m. This is the same merely-maximal predicate, not greatest degree, strict supremacy or an independently established existence claim.
